notes.title: New Update v1.1.4: Keyboard Configuration
notes.notes:
Yes Glyphs does indeed have keyboard configs and now you can set them to what you want as well as if you want to see the Tool Tips or not. Find the Settings Panel on the Main Screen or in the Game Screen when you click the blue Menu Button to leave the Game Screen.

As always if you have questions or problems then please post them here in the Community Hub and I'll get to them as soon as possible.

Thanks for all your comments on and your interest in Glyphs. It means a lot to me to see this community growing. :-)

Scott Kingdon
Glyphs Dev

notes.title: New Update v1.1.3: Tool Tips!
notes.notes:
As promised Glyphs now has tool tips for all the buttons in the game area. Also when you are testing your solution click on any tool and it will tell you what that tool is doing.

I hope you are enjoying the game and if you have any questions or comments I will get to them as soon as I can. Hope to hear from you.

notes.title: New Update For Glyphs: Apprentice
notes.notes: Glyphs now has a new debugging feature which allows you to see in game what your solution is doing at every single step. This will give you more control over your solution and allow you to solve puzzles easier without having to try to figure out where your solution went wrong.
